fee_notes: Royalty: 5% of Gross Sales or $45,000/year minimum ($3,750/mo) for new franchises; conversion franchises up to 5% depending on volume; renewing franchises same as existing agreement. National Brand Fund Fee currently 0.7% (max 1%). Regional/Local Marketing Fee max 3% of Gross Sales. Central Review Fee currently 0% (max 2% of CMIP Gross Sales).
raw_excerpt: Continuing Fee (New franchises): 5% of your Gross Sales or $45,000 per year, whichever is greater. National Brand Fund Fee: Maximum amount is 1% of your Gross Sales; currently, 0.7% of Gross Sales. Regional/Local Marketing Fee: Maximum amount is 3% of your Gross Sales.
